name: We for Yamuna
line: The campaign this organisation started as, in 2000. Still its spine.
deck: Our own words for it, then and now: a collective response towards growing apathy towards one of the most polluted rivers of the world. Everything else on this site grew out of this one line.

how.h: It is the oldest thing here
how.p: Founded in 2000, and it is still the reason the organisation exists rather than a chapter in its history. Every Yatra, every riverside walk and every shramdaan is downstream of it.

how.h: The opponent is apathy, not a factory
how.p: That was the framing on day one and it has not needed changing. A river with a hundred named polluters and no constituency does not get cleaned by naming the hundred.

done.p: The campaign is what Swechha was before Swechha was anything else. That is a real outcome. It is also the only one this page can honestly name.

holes.what: This campaign has no dated action and no stated demand on this page. Its whole story here is the founding story, which the About page already tells better.
holes.unlocks: One dated action and one demand — anything that is not the year 2000 — and this becomes a page instead of a row.

holes.what: The river's own numbers are on the situation page. Not one of them is attributed to this campaign, and we have not claimed one.
holes.unlocks: Any measured change we can honestly say we had a hand in.
